questions: How many samples (growths), islands and vortices did you measure, over how many cooldowns, and how many vortices showed the ZBCP? Your abstract says "MZMs are observed in all measured vortices", and the number would let readers weigh that.
Were any vortices or regions set aside, for example vortices sitting near defects or island edges, and why?
Which fields, temperatures and tip setpoints did you measure beyond the 1.0 T, 0.4 K, 500 pA and 1 nA shown, and which fields do Fig. 4B-D correspond to?
What does the second-best vortex look like, for example the core spectrum of each vortex in the two- and three-vortex maps of Fig. 4B-D? Is the vortex in Fig. 2 the same one as in Fig. 3?

In Fig. 3G, how did you fit the five levels (number of peaks fixed or free, peak widths, and the Δ and E_F you use for the FeTe branch), and how well does a half-integer sequence fit next to the integer one? From the listed energies, the ratio of the second to the first level is about 2.5 on the positive side and 2.3 on the negative side.
Along which directions relative to the six star rays do the white and orange arrows of Fig. 3A run, and does the ZBCP stay unsplit between the rays as well as along them?
Was the 0 T spectrum in Fig. 2I taken at the same spot as the 1.0 T core spectrum?

Does the ZBCP change as two vortices approach each other, or as a vortex sits closer to the island edge, given that a partner mode would sit at the island edge or at the bottom of the 20 unit cell FeTe film?
